parsed.observations: Leaves show elongated tan-brown necrotic areas, yellowing, and dried tips and margins. Dark markings occur within one damaged area, but blur prevents resolving individual black dots. No distinct pustules or white powdery growth are visible.
parsed.summary: The leaves have visible yellowing and necrosis, but diagnostic pustules, powdery growth, or clearly resolved pycnidia are absent, so the disease class is uncertain.
